stemMd: A workshop admits an applicant only if the applicant submits a portfolio. Lina was admitted. What must be true?

options.label: C
options.textMd: Everyone submitting a portfolio was admitted.

options.label: D
options.textMd: No rejected applicant submitted a portfolio.

explanationMd: The phrase only if makes submission necessary for admission. Since Lina was admitted, she must have submitted. The rule does not say that submission guarantees admission or reveals portfolio quality.

distractorRationale.c: The portfolio is necessary, not sufficient.
distractorRationale.a: Admission does not imply a ranking.
distractorRationale.d: Rejected applicants may have met the necessary condition.
